sections.label: Last Budget of term
sections.summary: Budget 2025 is the last Budget of this term of government, if all goes according to plan.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Budget 2025 is thus the last Budget of this term of government – at least, if all goes according to plan.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: Whilst every term of government has its fair share of ups and downs, this term was, in comparison, more like a roller coaster.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We had to battle the crisis of a generation, then adjust to a changed post-pandemic world.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: We barely had time to catch our breath before we had to grapple with the impact of wars in Europe and the Middle East, and while all this was going on, we simultaneously had to work on sharpening our competitive edge, refreshing our social compact and positioning ourselves for the future.

sentences.speaker: The Leader of the House (Ms Indranee Rajah)
sentences.text: So much has happened that I thought it would be appropriate to do a look back and consider what this House has – by approving the unprecedented number of Budgets brought before it – enabled us to achieve in this 14th Parliament.

sections.label: Pandemic health and jobs outcomes
sections.summary: Budget-resourced interventions achieved low case fatality and high vaccination rates, saved 165,000 jobs and supported self-employed persons.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Because of interventions resourced by these Budgets, we achieved one of the lowest overall case fatality rates and one of the highest vaccination rates in the world, without overwhelming our healthcare system.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We saved 165,000 jobs through the Jobs Support Scheme and supported self-employed persons through the Self-Employed Persons Income Relief Scheme.

sections.label: GST increase and Assurance Package
sections.summary: 2022 and 2023 Budgets raised GST for healthcare revenue and introduced the Assurance Package, enhanced from $6 billion to over $10 billion.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Under the Budgets of 2022 and 2023, we made the difficult decision to raise the Goods and Services Tax (GST) to ensure sufficient revenue to meet projected rising healthcare costs in light of a rapidly ageing population over the long term.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: However, we also introduced the Assurance Package to cushion Singaporeans, especially the lower- and middle- income, against the GST increase and later enhanced it several times, from the initial $6 billion to over $10 billion eventually, to buffer against inflation.

sections.label: Forward Singapore engagement exercise
sections.summary: In June 2022 the Forward Singapore exercise engaged over 200,000 Singaporeans, with findings published in October 2023.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Hence, in June 2022, we embarked on the Forward Singapore exercise.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We engaged over 200,000 Singaporeans and distilled the findings in a report published in October 2023.

sections.label: Steering Singapore through Budgets
sections.summary: Approval of successive Budgets steered Singapore through uncharted waters, with about $80 billion spent on the pandemic response, half from Past Reserves.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: When we look back through the lens of each Budget, what we see is that this House has, by its approval of the successive Budgets in this term, steadfastly steered Singapore through uncharted and choppy waters with decisiveness, agility and forward planning.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: We spent about $80 billion on the pandemic response, of which about half, or $40 billion, was drawn from Past Reserves.

sections.label: Largest Budget of term
sections.summary: A $143 billion Budget, the largest of this term, was just passed.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Minutes ago, we just passed a $143 billion Budget, the largest of this term.

sections.label: MPs filed Budget cuts
sections.summary: 61 MPs filed 600 cuts and spoke about 49 hours, with 41 30-second cuts filed by 13 MPs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: A total of 61 Members of Parliament filed 600 cuts, speaking for about 49 hours with respective Ministers in charge from the front-bench responding in turn.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: I know many Members wanted to file more cuts and wished they had more time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: There were, for the record, 41 30-second cuts filed by 13 Members of Parliament (MPs).

sections.label: Neil Parekh on fiscal surplus
sections.summary: Nominated MP Neil Parekh said Singapore and Singaporeans have a happy budgetary problem, as a fiscal surplus is better than a deficit.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Hon Nominated MP Mr Neil Parekh also reminded us that Singapore and Singaporeans have a happy budgetary problem – a fiscal surplus is definitely better than a fiscal deficit.

sections.label: Moving forward together
sections.summary: The passage says progress was earned through hard work, sacrifice and duty, and urges not taking unity, progress or stability for granted as Singapore approaches its 60th year of Independence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Every step forward has been earned through hard work, sacrifice and a deep sense of duty to one another.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: So, as we approach Singapore's 60th year of Independence, let us not take this unity, this progress or this stability for granted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Let us move forward and onward together with confidence, with determination and with the unwavering commitment to do what is best for Singapore and Singaporeans.
